p-bar-screentime.text:
The bar chart show the hours per week that people in four age group spend on three activity in 2023.

Overall, the young people use social media and gaming very much, 21 hours and 12 hours. Old people use less. Streaming video is same for every group.

People 13–17 years spend 21 hours on social media and people 18–29 spend 18 hours. People 30–49 spend 11 hours and people 50+ spend 6 hours. For gaming, 13–17 is 12 hours, 18–29 is 8 hours, 30–49 is 3 hours and 50+ is 1 hour.

Streaming video is 14 hours for 13–17, 15 hours for 18–29, 12 hours for 30–49 and 13 hours for 50+. It is not different.

slots.st1: people put old bottle in bottle bank and the lorry transport the bottle to recycling plant
slots.st2: the bottle is wash with high-pressure water
slots.st3: workers sort the bottle by colour and the glass is crush to small pieces
slots.st5: the glass is mould to new bottle
slots.st6: the bottle is fill and deliver to shop

p-proc-glass.text:
The diagram show how to recycle glass bottle.

Overall, there are 8 step. First is bottle bank and last is deliver to shop. It is a cycle.

First, people put old bottle in bottle bank. Then the lorry transport the bottle to recycling plant. The bottle is wash with high-pressure water. Then workers sort the bottle by colour, clear, green and brown. Then the glass is crush to small pieces, it is called cullet.

Next, the cullet is melt in furnace at 600–800 °C and they add new raw material. Then the glass is mould to new bottle. Finally, the bottle is fill and deliver to shop. People buy it and the cycle start again.

slots.place: the town centre in north-eastern Thailand
slots.extended: the road is bigger, four lanes

p-map-thai-town.text:
The maps show the town centre in north-eastern Thailand in 2005 and 2025.

In 2025 the town have many new building. The temple and the river is same. There is new hospital and new bridge.

In 2005, there is wet market, open field and temple in north of the road. In 2025, wet market change to covered market and open field change to car park. Temple is same. The temple is in north-east. The road is bigger, four lanes.

In 2005, there is wooden houses and rice fields in south. In 2025, wooden houses change to townhouses. Hospital is build on the rice fields in south-east, so rice fields is small now. Ferry change to bridge.

slots.what: the percent of teenager who have smartphone and basic phone
slots.feature: now almost every teenager have smartphone

p-line-phones.text:
The line graph show the percent of teenager who have smartphone and basic phone from 2010 to 2025.

Overall, smartphone go up from 10% to 95% and basic phone go down from 80% to 5%.

In 2010, 10% of teenager have smartphone. In 2013 it is 30%, in 2016 it is 60%, in 2019 it is 80%, in 2022 it is 90% and in 2025 it is 95%.

Basic phone is opposite. In 2010, 80% have basic phone. In 2013 it is 65%, in 2016 it is 40%, in 2019 it is 20%, in 2022 it is 10% and in 2025 it is 5%. Now almost every teenager have smartphone.
